'''Sylas Wilkes''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and held a high rank within the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[Exchange]].

==Biography==
Sylas was the first mate of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Andronikos Revel]] until he guided a mutiny against his captain. Later, he was stationed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] at his [[Wilkes' Base|base]], and was able to recover an artifact of the ancient [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tulak Hord]]. He and his bodyguards were defeated by the [[Sith Inquisitor]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> Wilkes was also killed in the same altercation after a brief verbal exchange between himself, Kallig and Revel.
